    neqsim.fluidmechanics.flowsystem.twophaseflowsystem.twophasepipeflowsystem.TwoPhasePipeFlowSystem.solveSteadyState(int)

    neqsim.process.chemistry.scale.ScaleControlAssessor.getResidualSI(ScaleInhibitorPerformance.ScaleType)
    use ScaleControlAssessor.getKineticRiskIndex(ScaleInhibitorPerformance.ScaleType); an inhibitor does not change thermodynamic SI

    neqsim.process.controllerdevice.ModelPredictiveController.setEnergyReference(double)
    Use ModelPredictiveController.setPreferredControlValue(double) when configuring the MPC economic target. This method is kept for compatibility with earlier code samples.
    neqsim.process.controllerdevice.ModelPredictiveController.setEnergyReferenceVector(double...)
    Use ModelPredictiveController.setPreferredControlVector(double...) to configure the nominal control point. This method is retained for backwards compatibility with earlier snapshots of the MPC implementation.
    neqsim.process.costestimation.CostEstimationCalculator.calcColumnShellCost(double)
    delegates to the deprecated weight-based vertical-vessel correlation. Use CostEstimationCalculator.calcVerticalVesselCostByVolume(double) with the column shell volume.
    neqsim.process.costestimation.CostEstimationCalculator.calcHorizontalVesselCost(double)
    the Turton horizontal-vessel coefficients take the vessel volume in m3 as their capacity basis, not the shell weight. Use CostEstimationCalculator.calcHorizontalVesselCostByVolume(double).
    neqsim.process.costestimation.CostEstimationCalculator.calcVerticalVesselCost(double)
    the Turton vertical-vessel coefficients take the vessel volume in m3 as their capacity basis, not the shell weight, so passing a weight over-estimates a large vessel by orders of magnitude. Use CostEstimationCalculator.calcVerticalVesselCostByVolume(double).
